EXPERIENCE · FEBRUARY — AUGUST 2022

Plastic Technology Intern

Organización Corona · Funza, Colombia

Manufacturing process improvement

At Organización Corona, I supported manufacturing engineering activities focused on plastic raw-material recovery, process monitoring, and production improvement.

My work combined production data analysis, statistical process control, and technical evaluation to identify opportunities to improve manufacturing performance and reduce material waste.

Main responsibilities

  • Plastic Raw-Material Recovery: Supported the technical and financial planning of a project focused on recovering plastic materials.
  • Statistical Process Control: Developed an SPC approach for monitoring plastic injection molding machines.
  • Production Data Analysis: Evaluated process data to identify variability, waste, and improvement opportunities.
  • Process Improvement: Supported the identification and evaluation of practical actions to improve manufacturing performance.
  • Team Collaboration: Worked with manufacturing and engineering teams to translate technical requirements into production improvements.

This experience strengthened my knowledge of manufacturing processes, statistical quality control, production analysis, and continuous improvement.
